This question asks whether the daily average temperature at Lyon–Saint Exupéry Airport will be higher on November 2, 2025 than on October 26, 2025. The forecast date is October 16, 2025, so we're predicting 10-17 days into the future.

In mid-to-late October transitioning to early November in Lyon, France, we expect cooling temperatures as autumn progresses toward winter. October 26 is earlier in the season than November 2, which is 7 days later. Typically, temperatures decline from late October into November in the Northern Hemisphere.

However, weather is variable. While the seasonal trend favors October 26 being warmer, individual day-to-day variations can be significant. A warm weather system could push temperatures up on November 2, or an early cold snap could make October 26 warmer.

Given the strong seasonal cooling trend from late October to early November, but accounting for weather variability, I estimate the probability that November 2 is warmer than October 26 at approximately 35-40%.
